summary: ERC-8286 合并为 Draft，为 ERC-7579 模块化账户定义 EIP-8141 frame 交易的验证扩展：验证器返回批准模式，账户在 VERIFY frame 中用 `APPROVE` 指令应用。soispoke 的 EIP-8141 `charged_gas` 费用结算修改合并。ERC-8262 零知识合规预言机合并。Vitalik 发布密码学混淆系列第二篇，讲 diamond iO。Barnabé 称 Lido 升级把验证者数减少近 30%。

items.topic: frame 交易与模块化账户
items.title: 新 ERC：Modular Accounts for Frame Transactions
items.note: （chiranjeev13）合并为 Draft，即 ERC-8286。ERC-7579 仍是核心模块系统，本 ERC 增加 EIP-8141 frame 交易的验证流程：验证器模块返回批准模式，账户在 VERIFY frame 中通过 `APPROVE` 指令应用。
items.title_en: New ERC: Modular Accounts for Frame Transactions
items.note_en: (chiranjeev13), merged as a Draft, ERC-8286. ERC-7579 stays the core module system, and this ERC adds the validation flow for EIP-8141 frame transactions: a validator module returns an approval mode that the account applies via the `APPROVE` instruction during a VERIFY frame.

items.title: EIP-8141：费用结算采用 charged_gas
items.note: （soispoke）合并，退款、calldata 下限和区块 gas 计数统一按 `charged_gas` 计算。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: apply charged_gas to fee settlement
items.note_en: (soispoke), merged, so refunds, the calldata floor and block gas accounting all follow `charged_gas`.

items.title: 新 ERC：零知识合规预言机
items.note: （DROOdotFOO）合并为 Draft，即 ERC-8262：用户在客户端生成证明，证明自己满足特定司法辖区的 AML、制裁筛查和反拆分阈值，不暴露金额、交易对手或筛查细节，不需要可信第三方或 TEE。
items.note_en: (DROOdotFOO), merged as a Draft, ERC-8262: users generate proofs client-side that they meet jurisdiction-specific AML, sanctions screening and anti-structuring thresholds without revealing amounts, counterparties or screening details, with no trusted third party or TEE.

summary_en: ERC-8286 merged as a Draft, defining an EIP-8141 frame transaction validation extension for ERC-7579 modular accounts: a validator returns an approval mode that the account applies with the `APPROVE` instruction in a VERIFY frame. soispoke's EIP-8141 `charged_gas` fee settlement change merged. ERC-8262, a zero-knowledge compliance oracle, merged. Vitalik published the second part of his cryptographic obfuscation series, on diamond iO. Barnabé said a Lido upgrade cuts its validator count by almost 30%.
